mapper.select: SELECT pt.*, wo.work_order_name, wo.status AS work_order_status, wo.priority AS work_order_priority, m.name AS material_name, m.model AS material_model, m.standard AS material_standard, mc.name AS category_name, u.login_name AS worker_login_name, u.position AS worker_position, u.department AS worker_department, u.phonenum AS worker_phone, ws.skill_level, ws.skill_score, ws.efficiency_rate, ws.quality_rate AS worker_quality_rate, cu.username AS create_user_name, uu.username AS update_user_name FROM jsh_production_task pt LEFT JOIN jsh_production_work_order wo ON pt.work_order_id = wo.id AND IFNULL(wo.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_material m ON pt.product_id = m.id AND IFNULL(m.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_material_category mc ON m.category_id = mc.id AND IFNULL(mc.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_user u ON pt.worker_id = u.id AND IFNULL(u.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_worker_skill ws ON pt.worker_id = ws.worker_id AND ws.skill_type = pt.task_type AND IFNULL(ws.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_user cu ON pt.create_user = cu.id AND IFNULL(cu.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_user uu ON pt.update_user = uu.id AND IFNULL(uu.delete_flag, '0') != '1' WHERE pt.id = #{id} AND IFNULL(pt.delete_flag, '0') != '1'

SELECT pt.*, m.name AS material_name, u.username AS worker_login_name, ws.skill_level, ws.skill_score FROM jsh_production_task pt LEFT JOIN jsh_material m ON pt.product_id = m.id AND IFNULL(m.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_user u ON pt.worker_id = u.id AND IFNULL(u.delete_flag, '0') != '1' LEFT JOIN jsh_worker_skill ws ON pt.worker_id = ws.worker_id AND ws.skill_type = pt.task_type AND IFNULL(ws.delete_flag, '0') != '1' WHERE pt.work_order_id = #{workOrderId} AND IFNULL(pt.delete_flag, '0') != '1' ORDER BY pt.create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE jsh_production_task SET worker_id = #{workerId}, worker_name = #{workerName}, assign_time = #{assignTime}, status = 'ASSIGNED', update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id} AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'
UPDATE jsh_production_task SET start_time = #{startTime}, status = 'IN_PROGRESS', update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id} AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'

UPDATE jsh_production_task SET complete_time = #{completeTime}, completed_quantity = #{completedQuantity}, qualified_quantity = #{qualifiedQuantity}, defective_quantity = #{defectiveQuantity}, actual_hours = #{actualHours}, status = 'COMPLETED', update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user = #{updateUser} WHERE id = #{id} AND IFNULL(delete_flag, '0') != '1'
